facts.fact: The LISGIS microdata catalogue lists the anonymised Liberia Annual Agricultural Survey 2024 household dataset as a Public Use File accessible to all for statistical and research purposes, released as version 1.0 (record last modified 1 July 2026); redistribution needs LISGIS written agreement, so no open licence is stated.
The catalogue record for the survey dataset shows 273 downloads and 21,875 page views, as shown on the record at the document date (1 July 2026).
